title: Live-Action High School Family: Kokosei Kazoku Film Reveals 12 Cast Members
content:
The official website for the live-action film of Ryō Nakama 's High School Family: Kokosei Kazoku ( Kōkōsei Kazoku ) manga revealed 12 new cast members for the film on Thursday.

The new cast members include:

• Masaya Kimura as Seitarō Naruse

• Miyu Honda as Kotone Akai

• Yūka Kageyama as Arisa Yumiki

• Anna Kurasawa as Riko Yashiki

• Ryōtarō Sakaguchi as Takumi Kitayama

• Rintarō Mizusawa as Tōru Suzaki

• Kōdai Fujimoto as Hayato Sano

• Ryūshin Ozawa as Ayumu Kurokawa

• Sōma Santoki as Seiji Kakei

• naenano as Yuki

• Yuzu Ashikawa as Kana

• Rin Ōmasa as Nobukatsu Takebayashi

The film will open in Japan on January 8, a delay from the film's originally planned fall 2026 opening.

Viz Media and MANGA Plus are both publishing the series in English digitally, and MANGA Plus describes the story:

Spring is in the air, and Kotaro is about to begin his first year of high school. He's full of hope and anticipation of a wonderful life at his new school, only to have his dreams crushed by...his family?! Isobe Isobee Monogatari ~ Ukiyo wa Tsuraiyo creator Ryō Nakama 's latest series combines family and school life gags, making it feel familiar but also fresh and new. This new genre of comedy will be sure to make the grade!

The film stars (left to right in visual right):

• Yuno Nagao (live-action Golden Kamuy, 2024's Black Jack) plays the younger sister Haruka

• Shingo Katori (Lil' Red Riding Hood Cha-Cha, Friends: Mononoke Shima no Naki) plays the father Ichiro

• Jun Saitō (Labyrinth, live-action Let's Go Karaoke!, Trillion Game) plays the eldest son Kōtarō

• Riisa Naka (The Girl Who Leapt Through Time, live-action Cells at Work!) plays the mother Shizuka

Tôichirô Rutô (live-action Violence Action, G Men, Ossan's Love ) is directing the film based on a script by Europe Kikaku 's Makoto Ueda ( The Tatami Galaxy , Night is Short, Walk On Girl , Penguin Highway ).

Nakama launched the manga in Shueisha 's Weekly Shonen Jump magazine in September 2020 and ended the series in Weekly Shonen Jump in February 2023. Shueisha published the11th and final volume in July 2023. Viz Media is also publishing the manga in compiled volume form digitally.

Nakama previously published the Isobe Isobee Monogatari ~Ukiyo wa Tsurai yo~ manga in Weekly Shonen Jump from October 2013 to October 2017. The manga inspired two net anime series and a stage play.

title: I'm Dating a Dark Summoner Anime's Character Video Highlights Imp
content:
The Deregula anime label began streaming a new character video for the short anime of Shaoh 's I'm Dating a Dark Summoner ( Dark Summoner to Dekiteiru ) manga on Wednesday. The video highlights the character Imp.

The company is releasing two more character videos over the next two days.

The anime will premiere in October. HIDIVE will stream the anime.

The main cast members are:

• Rei Takano as Amona

• Yūki Nishiyama as Roni

• Hōden Tei Senmai as Imp

Seiya Miyajima ( Umayon , BanG Dream! Girls Band Party! Pico ) is directing as well as overseeing and writing the series scripts. Takahiro Sasaki ( Chronicles of the Going Home Club ) is the character designer and chief animation director. Other staff members include:

• Sound Director: Fumihiko Ōtera

• Art Director: Yōichirō Yamamoto

• Color Design: Daiki Ura (DEFA)

• Director of Photography: Tasuku Ozu

• Editing: Toma Hayashima

• Producer: Yasuhiro Aoki, Kōta Hashiguchi

• Animation Studio: AtoriE

• Animation Assistance: Nyan Pollution-ω-

The fantasy manga's story begins when Amona, a demi-human dark summoner who uses the power of demons, joins the party of the righteous cleric Roni. Everyone thought that they would be at each other's throats within a minute, but by the end of Amona's first day in the party, they share a passionate night together.

WWWave Corporation 's Deregula anime label is producing the anime. WWWave Corporation owns the ComicFesta web manga service, as well as the AnimeFesta anime programming block.

Shaoh launched the manga in Kadokawa 's Dra Dra Sharp# online manga magazine in 2021. Kadokawa published the manga's seventh compiled book volume on March 9.

title: It’s Easier Than Ever to Catch Up on Crunchyroll’s Darkest New Anime
content:
The latest Summer 2026 anime season brings several exciting series for fans. As always, Crunchyroll is the greatest hub for all the latest anime series, including a surprisingly dark anime of the season. Jaadugar: A Witch in Mongolia is making waves among fans as one of the best series of the year. Produced by the renowned animation studio Science SARU, this historical series is based on an acclaimed manga series written and illustrated by Tomato Soup. Apart from this globally renowned Shonen Jump series, Dandadan , the studio is known for releasing several unique anime films and series ever since its establishment in 2013, including the latest Ghost in the Shell reboot. Every anime from the studio offers unique animation along with a captivating story, and this latest anime doesn’t disappoint at all.

Jaadugar: A Witch in Mongoli a premiered with a one-hour special broadcast, which was broken into two episodes on the streaming service as viewers learn about Sitara, the protagonist of the story. The anime finally premiered its English dub on July 18th, 2026. While the story is taking shape in the initial episodes, the new main visual highlights the central characters. Before the premiere, only the first half was revealed, and now the official website has released the full version of the visual.

What Is Jaadugar: A Witch in Mongolia About?

Beneath the stellar and adorable animation style, the series is much more complex and nuanced as it tackles some dark themes of war and slavery. The story takes place in the 13th-century Mongol Empire, where a young girl named Sitara was driven away from her homeland after the death of her mother and ended up in a slave market.

She was eventually picked up by a family of scholars who encouraged her to learn everything she could. However, after spending several years with them, her life came crashing down when the Tus Militia fell at the hands of the Nomads. It didn’t take long for homes and lives to be destroyed by the Nomads, forcing Sitara away from her home once again. However, following the tragedy, Sitara’s destiny begins to change as the story follows her journey, where she later becomes known as the Witch of Mongolia for her advanced intellectual mastery of medicine and geometry.

Jaadugar: A Witch in Mongolia Is A Must-Watch For Anime Fans

The series has one of the most unique animation styles seen in the industry, as it perfectly does justice to the art style of the manga. Each scene has fluid movements, and the attention to detail in every frame is awe-inspiring. Thanks to Inu-Oh and Heike Monogatari , Science SARU is famous for blending historical settings with a hand-drawn aesthetic and fluid movements. The animation in the latest series surpasses even those acclaimed classics, and it wouldn’t be an exaggeration to say it’s by far the best series from the studio.

Everything from the soundtrack to the character action is cinematic enough to portray the appeal of a beautifully crafted masterpiece. The gorgeous animation is to be expected considering that the anime has an impressive staff with several industry veterans contributing to this gorgeous project. Naoko Yamada, the director of the award-winning movie A Silent Voice , will be serving as the general director, while Abel Gongora is the anime director.

title: Parasyte Gets New Parasyte: Tamiya Live-Action Series on Netflix in 2027
content:
Netflix announced on Thursday that it is developing a new live-action series based on Hitoshi Iwaaki 's Parasyte ( Kiseiju ) manga. The new series, titled Parasyte : Tamiya , will stream on Netflix globally in 2027.

The anime is based on the character of Ryoko Tamiya, a key character in the original Parasyte manga. Netflix describes the story:

This new series tells the story of Ryoko Tamiya, a very levelheaded and “human” parasite who begins to question how, or if, parasites and humans can coexist. Seen through Tamiya's eyes, the world of Parasyte becomes a lens on survival, identity and what it really means to be human. In the original manga, Ryoko Tamiya is a parasite who takes over the body of a high school teacher and becomes an antagonist for Shinichi Izumi. Initially a brutal parasite that attacks humans indiscriminately, Tamiya learns a great deal about humanity through her job as a teacher. Upon seeing Shinichi and Migi sharing a body, she begins to think that coexistence with humanity will give her species the best chance at survival.

Shioli Kutsuna ( Deadpool , live-action Detective Conan , Kingsglaive: Final Fantasy XV , Neko Atsume House ) stars in the anime as Ryoko Tamiya.

Yeon Sang-ho , who directed the previous Parasyte: The Grey series, is credited as planner, and is also co-writing the script alongside returning scriptwriter Ryu Yong-jae . Kensaku Kakimoto (live-action Glass Heart ) and Kazuhiro Nakagawa (live-action Double , Hakubo no Chronicle ) are directing the series. WOWPOINT also returns to develop and produce the series.

Parasyte: The Grey ( Kiseiju: The Grey ), the South Korean live-action adaptation , debuted worldwide on Netflix in April 2024.

Iwaaki's original manga was serialized in Kodansha 's Afternoon magazine from 1990-1995.

Kodansha USA published the series in English. The company also published the Neo Kiseijū tribute manga series under the title Neo Parasyte m in 2017, which features stories by different artists, including Ohta. The tribute manga ran from September 2014 to March 2016 in Kodansha 's Afternoon magazine.

The manga most recently inspired a television anime adaptation in 2014, and two live-action films in 2014 and 2015.

Moare Ohta debuted the Parasyte Reversi ( Kiseijū Reversi ) action-horror manga based on the original series on Kodansha 's Comic Days service in March 2018, and ended it in May 2021. Kodansha published the manga's eighth and final compiled book volume in July 2021. Kodansha USA publishes the series in English.

title: Yellow Tanabe's Kai-hen Wizards Manga Resumes on July 29
content:
Manga creator Yellow Tanabe announced on Tuesday that her Kai-hen Wizards ( Kaihen no Mahōtsukai ) manga will resume in this year's 35th issue of Weekly Shonen Sunday magazine on July 29. The manga went on hiatus on February 9.

The manga previously went on hiatus in January 2025, and returned in April 2025. The manga then went on hiatus again in June 2025 and returned in November 2025.

Tanabe launched the series in Weekly Shonen Sunday in September 2024. Shogakukan published the manga's fourth compiled book volume on June 18. Viz Media releases the manga's English simulpub, and describes the story:

A young boy must live in exile lest his deadly magical powers destroy the world.

Tanabe began serializing the Kekkaishi manga in Weekly Shonen Sunday in 2003 and ended it after eight years in 2011. The manga inspired a television anime that ran from 2006 to 2008. Viz Media released the anime in a set of four DVDs in 2011, and Discotek Media later released the anime on Blu-ray Disc in June 2022.

Tanabe launched the Birdmen manga in Weekly Shonen Sunday in July 2013, and ended it in February 2020.

title: Liar Game: The Last Game Manga Ends
content:
The August issue of Shueisha 's Grand Jump Mecha magazine published the final chapter of Shinobu Kaitani 's Liar Game : The Last Game manga on Wednesday. The manga will be compiled as the 20th volume of the original Liar Game manga, and will ship on October 19.

The manga launched in Shueisha 's Grand Jump Mucha magazine on February 25, but it also began serialization in the sister magazine Grand Jump Mecha on May 27. The manga is set after the ending of the original manga, and centers on Nao tackling a new "game."

The manga inspired an upcoming television anime that debuted on April 6, and is still ongoing. Anime distributor REMOW introduces the series:

A Mysterious Invitation. One Hundred Million Yen. The Game Begins. College student Nao Kanzaki suddenly receives a strange letter and a suitcase containing 100 million yen. She's been chosen to participate in the LIAR GAME —a high-stakes psychological battle where lies, deception, and betrayal reign supreme. Naïve and painfully honest, Nao quickly finds herself cornered. To survive, she turns to Shinichi Akiyama, a brilliant former con artist with unmatched intellect. As they dive deeper into the twisted game, the two must outwit opponents in a world where trusting others could be fatal. In a game built on lies, can honesty prevail?

The original manga ran from 2005 to January 2015 in Shueisha 's Weekly Young Jump magazine. Shueisha published the manga's 19th compiled book volume in May 2015.

The manga previously inspired two live-action films, two live-action television series, and two live-action online series. The manga also inspired a stage play in 2023.

Kaitani's ONE OUTS manga inspired a television anime in 2008.
author: ANN

title: Live-Action Wandance Film Reveals 4 New Cast Members
content:
The official website for the live-action film of Coffee 's Wandance manga revealed character videos and character visuals for four new cast members on Wednesday.

Kira Yamaguchi as On Miyao

Ran Mazzel as Iori Itsukushima

Tsukki as Gaku Kabeya

Aloha Takamatsu as Usen Takumi

The film will open in Japan on November 27.

Kodansha USA Publishing releases the manga and describes the story:

A boy named Kaboku sees a girl named Wanda dance, and suddenly burns with a need to join in. With its thrilling scenes of Japanese hip-hop dance and quirky, charming characters, this is a new, inspirational manga for fans of coming-of-age stories like Blue Period and Your Lie in April . Get up and join the Wandance ! Kaboku has always just gone with the flow, marching in step to the drumbeat of the expectations of those around him: parents, school, plans for the future. It feels predictable, safe, and… empty. But one night, Kaboku's at school late, and he happens on a girl alone, moving wildly, turning a blank space of concrete into a canvas. This is Hikari Wanda, a member of the hip-hop dance club. Kaboku is immediately smitten, but the road to stepping out of his shell is a long one. The club is almost entirely girls, and they're all, well, way better than him. What's ahead is unknown, and that's terrifying, but it also means, for the first time in Kaboku's life… a taste of freedom.

&Team boy band member JO plays the film's protagonist Kaboku Kotani, and Anji Ikehata ( Yano-kun no Futsū no Hibi , Lonely Castle in the Mirror ) stars as Hikari Wanda.

Naoya Kusaba is directing the film, with a script by Keiichi Kobayashi . Dancer and entrepreneur Charisma Kantarō is supervising the film's dances.

Coffee launched the manga in Afternoon magazine in 2019, and is simultaneously published in Kodansha 's Magazine Pocket app. Kodansha published the manga's 15th compiled book volume in December 2025. Kodansha USA Publishing will release the 14th volume in English on November 2026.

A television anime adaptation debuted in Japan in October 2025. Disney+ streamed the anime as it aired in Japan.

title: Cross Infinite World Licenses Assassin Empress Bellreuge, The Villainess' Journal, 2 More Light Novels
content:
Cross Infinite World announced on Wednesday that it has licensed the following light novels for release in August-October.

“That leaves me no choice. If I don't become the villainess he's looking for, all of my data will be destroyed. How did it ever come to this?”

Estelle decides to live as a villainess to protect her precious research, all while keeping a journal of her daily life at the home of the Ice Marquess.

title: King of the Hill Star Teases Bill’s Romantic Future After Hitting Rock Bottom (Exclusive)
content:
King of the Hill ‘s revival has seen a Bill Dauterive has been at his lowest point in the animated series to date, and the voice star behind him is teasing a brighter future for him moving forward into the next season and beyond. One of the best aspects of King of the Hill’ s return to Hulu has been seeing all of the characters age and grow in the time since the end of the original series. But it was a bit rough for Bill’s part of it all as he became even more of a sad sack than before .

This continues through King of the Hill Season 15 now streaming with Hulu. But there have been slight changes that seem to tease that Bill’s future is going to be different now that his friends are helping him after hitting rock bottom . Speaking to ComicBook about the new season, Bill voice star Stephen Root teased that in the now recording Season 16 of the series, Bill’s romantic life is starting to change as he heads into a brighter future, “We’re moving in the direction of Bill being mature enough to have a real girlfriend, not a comic one.”

King of the Hill’s Bill Might Get a Girlfriend

“I think we’re heading in that direction because everybody is is growing up a little bit,” Bill voice actor Stephen Root revealed when asked if Bill has a potential for actual romance in his future. “I think by the time this season ends, and the new season which we’ve started recording, we’re moving in the direction of Bill being mature enough to have a real girlfriend, not a comic one. I’m very much in favor of that.” Bill goes through some very tough things this season as while the show’s not getting darker , Bill’s getting more desperate for human connection.

“I think with the way the show’s going, I think it’d be harder to get into a hugely dark place with Bill,” Root said of Bill’s current direction at the end of King of the Hill Season 15 . “I think as an audience member, I liked to see where he was headed as he goes down into the depths. It might be rock bottom for this season…but I think Bill’s gonna get a little better.” Looking back on Bill in the original series compared to now, Root also appreciates that Bill’s friends are seeing him differently too.

How Bill Evolves in King of the Hill’s Future

“He had a lot of problems, and it was it was great to be able to come out of those problems and have the rest of his friends not only tolerate him, which I think they did in the first iteration of the show,” Root explained. “He was a buddy, but it’s like anybody else. Sometimes you just tolerate a friend .” As Root reveals, that’s changed a great deal for Bill in the revival, “I think that’s changed dramatically in this new version of it, where they’re trying to make him a better person. That he can now actually go out in society and and be useful.”

King of the Hill did have Bill head into his roughest patch yet with his addition to cuddle therapy in “No-Cuddle Offense,” but Hank and the others promise to directly help him get his life together. With King of the Hill Season 16 confirmed to be fully written , and Root teasing that recording for the season has already begun, it does raise some hopes that fans will get to see a much better situation for Bill moving forward.

title: 3 Deep-Cut 2000s Animated Shows That Are Worth Watching From Beginning to End
content:
Animated revivals are coming in fast and furious these days, as various universes are making comebacks even with decades passing after their original finales. While shows like King of the Hill , Futurama , and The Amazing World of Gumball have all returned, there are some series that might never be lucky enough to return to the screen. Luckily, now feels like the right time to highlight three “deep-cut” shows that are worth watching from the start to their original end. While these shows might never return, they are very much worth your time if you are looking to revisit the animation of the aughts.

3.) Chowder

Cartoon Network has seen its fair share of big animated originals go on to receive serious glory, with the likes of Adventure Time, Regular Show , and The Powerpuff Girls being only three examples. Unfortunately, not every original from the cable network’s history will hit the same heights, which is especially tragic for Chowder . First arriving on Cartoon Network in 2007, the series garnered three seasons before coming to a close while focusing on its feline culinary student. Created by animator C.H. Greenblatt, Chowder’s world was unlike any other, and across its three-season run, the series blended humor with astonishing animation that often has to be seen to be believed. Throughout the entirety of the series, Chowder works well at not just delivering hilarity, but also creating unique characters that bounce off one another to make one of Cartoon Network’s best animated originals. Greenblatt has said in the past that he’d love to revisit this universe with a brand new prequel series, though Warner Bros originally shot down the idea, leaving it unlikely that we’ll see the new Chowder show arrive anytime soon.

2.) Spider-Man: The New Animated Series

It’s fair to say that X-Men ’97 has been a massive success as Marvel’s Merry Mutants have hit a new stride with its second season. Thanks to Xavier’s finest pulling in a lot of attention, many fans have been wondering if Fox’s Spider-Man: The Animated Series might be given a revival as well. What many might not know is that in 2003, a thirteen-episode animated series introduced the world to a surprising new take on the wallcrawler. Airing on MTV in the U.S., the CG animated series followed Peter Parker during his time at college, with How I Met Your Mother’s Neil Patrick Harris playing the part of your friendly neighborhood wallcrawler. The animated show takes place in a world quite like Sam Raimi’s original film trilogy, but brought in many villains that hadn’t made their way to the silver screen at that time. Villains like the Lizard, Electro, Kraven the Hunter, Silver Sable, and more all rounded out the roster, with even Michael Clarke Duncan returning to his role as the Kingpin from the Daredevil live-action film. If you’re a fan of Spider-Man , this long-lost MTV series might be well worth your time.

1.) Clerks : The Animated Series

Bringing back the likes of Dante, Randall, Jay, and Silent Bob from their original appearance in the live-action Clerks film, the hilarious six-episode series is a quick watch while also being gut-bustingly hilarious. On top of having many of the actors reprise their roles from the 1994 black-and-white comedy, the show even added in the villainous Leonardo Leonardo, played by Alec Baldwin. Even with only half a dozen installments to its name, you can still easily pick up Clerks: The Animated Series and find it relevant to today’s events. Kevin Smith was in charge of these animated adventures, landing before the film would receive two sequels that further explored the lives of Dante and Randall. There are so many moments from the series that have gained internet immortality thanks to the surge of memes sweeping the world wide web, proving that even with only six episodes to its name, Clerks still has staying power to this day.
